summary: The Warshade Halls are the disciplined training sanctum of the War‑Shade Expanse. Here, War‑Shades are shaped, drilled, attuned, and commanded. Discord energy flows through ritual conduits, forging soldiers from shadow and corruption.
history: Constructed after the First Fracture to organize War‑Shade manifestations.
Muramite commanders attempted to seize the halls but were repelled by shadow wards.
Discord‑forged architects expanded the halls into a multi‑tier command structure.
The Halls became the central training ground for elite War‑Shade units.
Shadow conduits were added to accelerate War‑Shade attunement.
